title: Network Intrusion Forensic Detection System with Explainable Artificial Intelligence and Digital Chain of Custody
abstract: arXiv:2611.06173v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deploying an explainable intrusion detection model from a validated laboratory setting into a forensic workflow requires guarantees that benchmarks do not test: that the certified model is the exact artifact applied to a case, that heterogeneous evidence can be classified reliably, and that every step is verifiable. We present MODEXRE, a forensic pipeline that extends a previously validated synthetic-data-trained XGBoost classifier with SHAP explainability (arXiv:2607.00763) into a dual-mode architecture: a Laboratory mode, where models are trained and certified on public and synthetic data, and a Formal mode, where a frozen, hash-verified model performs inference on case evidence under a SHA-256 hash-chained chain of custody. Suricata alerts, CEF firewall logs and packet captures are normalized through OCSF. Four design decisions, each triggered by an observed failure, shaped the architecture: a timestamp leak that inflated Kitsune pe

translated_title: 基于可解释人工智能与数字证据链的网络入侵取证检测系统
translated_abstract: 摘要：将一个在实验室环境中经过验证的可解释入侵检测模型部署到实际取证工作流中，需要满足基准测试无法检验的保证：即经过认证的模型正是应用于具体案件的那个确切产物、异构证据能够被可靠地分类，以及每一步操作均可验证。我们提出了MODEXRE，一个取证流水线，它将此前已在合成数据上验证过的、带有SHAP可解释性的XGBoost分类器（arXiv:2607.00763）扩展为双模式架构：实验室模式，模型在公开数据和合成数据上进行训练与认证；正式模式，一个被冻结的、经哈希验证的模型在SHA-256哈希链式数字证据链下对案件证据执行推理。Suricata告警、CEF防火墙日志和数据包捕获均通过OCSF进行归一化处理。四个设计决策塑造了该架构，每一个决策都源于一次实际观察到的失败：例如一个导致Kitsune性能被虚高评估的时间戳泄露问题……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出MODEXRE取证流水线，将经过验证的SHAP可解释XGBoost入侵检测模型扩展为“实验室模式+正式模式”双模式架构，在SHA-256哈希链式数字证据链保障下，对经OCSF归一化的多源异构网络证据执行可验证且可解释的取证推理。
en_tdlr: The paper presents MODEXRE, a forensic pipeline that extends a validated SHAP-explainable XGBoost intrusion detection model into a dual-mode (Laboratory/Formal) architecture, enabling verifiable and explainable forensic inference on OCSF-normalized heterogeneous network evidence under a SHA-256 hash-chained chain of custody.
